name: posthog-feature-revenue-impact
description: Measure whether a specific feature rollout moved revenue: split users on feature-flag or experiment exposure and compare downstream Stripe revenue and retention between the exposed cohort and control, saved as a reusable PostHog insight. Use this whenever someone wants the revenue impact of an experiment or a feature they shipped, wants to tie a feature flag or A/B test to revenue and retention, or asks whether a rollout paid off. Triggers on phrasings like 'did the feature we shipped move revenue', 'revenue impact of our experiment', 'did the rollout pay off', 'compare exposed vs control on revenue', 'feature flag revenue lift', or 'A/B test revenue'. Boundary: this is a before/after causal test tied to a specific flag or experiment. For ranking which EXISTING features high-revenue customers already use, use posthog-features-drive-revenue. It sets up the Stripe source if needed and builds the insight end-to-end.
